title: host-overhead-profiling
summary: Detect and diagnose CPU/host overhead in inference serving from nsys traces. Answers: is host overhead the bottleneck? What specific work is causing it? Covers GPU idle ratio, host-prep exposed ratio, NVTX breakdown, inter-kernel gap analysis, and multi-rank straggler detection.
